description: This file is a PHPUnit test case for the Cryptographer utility class within the OrangeHRM system. It contains tests for encrypting and decrypting functions to verify cryptographic correctness.

classes.name: CryptographerTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the Cryptographer utility functions.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the Cryptographer instance with a predefined key before each test.

methods.name: testEncrypt
methods.description: Tests the encryption method to ensure it produces the expected output.

methods.name: testDecrypt
methods.description: Tests the decryption method to verify it correctly reverses encryption.

methods.name: testEncryptDecrypt
methods.description: Verifies that encrypting and then decrypting a value returns the original value.
